summary: Iteration 26 verification: seller add-item wizard P0 fix (pickedColors crash), shared/community categories, canonicalisation (near-duplicate + plural), and variant matrix. Backend: 15/15 pytest passed (categories list/search/audience/POST auth + near-dup merge, items canonicalisation on POST+PATCH, explicit-variants get UUIDs, ids preserved by (size,colour) on PATCH, sizes roll-up excludes disabled combos, buyer discovery by community slug). Regression: buyer register (gender required), seller register (Location object required with city+country), /auth/me, seller analytics platform_fee_bps=1500, payments/checkout returns Paystack authorization_url. Frontend: buyer discover chip strip loads community categories from GET /api/categories (cat-swimwear present and tappable, list container still renders). Seller add-item wizard step 1 -> step 2 (Taxonomy: audience + community category search 'swim' surfaces wizard-cat-swimwear) -> step 3 (Sizing) navigation completes WITHOUT the 'pickedColors is not defined' ReferenceError. Sizing step renders unit toggle, size chips and colour palette correctly.

issues: Login screen shows deprecation warnings in console: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' - React Native web deprecation warnings, non-blocking but should be migrated.

action_items: Optional cleanup: purge the two TEST community categories created by the backend tests before republishing so the seller category picker isn't polluted: db.categories.deleteMany({slug: {$regex: '^testkikoy'}}) - both slugs currently visible in the seller taxonomy picker and buyer chip strip (testkikoy98c2e6wrap, testkikoyde882cwrap).
Minor: /app/backend/routers/categories.py line 52 defines SYSTEM_SLUGS but never uses it - dead code, safe to delete.
Cosmetic React Native web deprecation warnings on login screen ('shadow*' style props and props.pointerEvents) - migrate to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents to silence Metro warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: categories.py find_canonical() correctly handles plural/singular (swimwears <-> swimwear) and 0.85-cutoff difflib for misspellings (swimware -> swimwear). Idempotent create verified end-to-end.
items.py POST + PATCH both go through resolve_or_create_slug() so free-text edits ('Swim Wear', 'swimwears') always land on canonical slug 'swimwear' - verified.

core/variants.py rollup_sizes_qty() correctly excludes disabled combos from per-size available_qty roll-up - verified L=3 (Coral disabled 2 excluded) in test_patch_item_category_and_variant_id_preservation.
PATCH variant id preservation by (size_label, _norm_name(color_name)) key works - verified all 4 (S,L)x(Coral,Navy) ids stable across PATCH.

success_rate.frontend: P0 crash fix verified + buyer community-category discovery verified

seed_data_creation: Test buyer & test seller accounts created via /auth/register with unique @example.com emails (prefixed TESTbuyer_ / TESTseller_). Two TEST community categories (testkikoy98c2e6wrap / testkikoyde882cwrap) created via POST /api/categories and NOT cleaned up - they'll persist in the shared catalog. One TEST swim item created + deleted (cleanup ran).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Community categories persist across runs (no cleanup endpoint exists). Frontend .env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Login flow requires clicking 'I ALREADY HAVE AN ACCOUNT' -> role toggle testID login-intent-buyer|seller -> fill login-email-input + login-password-input -> click login-submit-btn. Add-item wizard is at /add-item; three steps (basics/taxonomy/sizing). Photo upload goes through page.expect_file_chooser() on wizard-photo-add-library. Buyer register requires gender (buyers), seller register requires location as {city, country} object. Checkout requires size (not size_label), origin_url, and address_id. Uncovered scenarios: publishing full item from wizard, buyer item detail variant selection with disabled combo + price override, shoes EU size chip rendering - main agent should self-verify these since they take significant browser-automation time.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no regressions found. Main agent's fix for the pickedColors ReferenceError (moving the matrix JSX inside StepSizing where pickedColors is a valid closure variable) is verified end-to-end via browser automation reaching step 3 without React error boundary firing.
